With N=2^n root assignments, successor quotient size 2^N-N gives T_n=N(2^N-N) pointed types. Explicit root minterms and Delta-chi_a clauses isolate every type at depth one. The counting information bound 2^N-N>2^(N-1) for n>=2 proves N yes/no tests minimal even adaptively, with sharp exceptions n=0,1.
